items.title: AutoTerm-SST: Adaptive Terminology Memory with Zero Session-Time Setup for Streaming Speech Translation
items.summary: arXiv:2610.26865v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Retrieval-augmented speech translation improves rare terminology, but systems such as RASST still assume that users provide a glossary before each session. That assumption is inconvenient for live talks, while merging every domain into one growing glossary eventually places too many irrelevant terms in the same retrieval and prompt competition. We present AutoTerm-SST, an interactive system that removes session-time glossary upload and domain selec
items.summary_zh: AutoTerm-SST 提出零会话前置的自适应术语记忆，解决流式语音翻译中术语检索需预先提供词表的痛点。
items.why_zh: 展示流式语音翻译中动态术语检索与自适应记忆机制的工程落地，属 RAG 与实时系统结合技能点。

items.title: Industrial Agentic AI: LLM-Driven New-Generation Agents for Smart Manufacturing
items.summary: arXiv:2610.26941v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are enabling agents to move beyond predefined workflows toward autonomous planning and execution, creating new opportunities for smart manufacturing. However, dynamic environments, complex physical constraints, and stringent reliability requirements hinder the direct deployment of general-purpose agents in smart manufacturing. This article presents a systematic overview of LLM-driven industrial agents. First, we analyze
items.summary_zh: 论文探讨 LLM 驱动的新一代智能体在智能制造中的应用，针对动态环境、物理约束与可靠性要求提出部署框架。
items.why_zh: 涵盖 Agent 规划、工具调用与工业物理约束融合的工程实践，属具身智能与工业落地技能点。

items.title: Navalia: Advancing Cowork Agents through Verifiable Task Synthesis and Long-Horizon Post-Training
items.summary: arXiv:2610.26887v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are evolving from conversational assistants into Cowork Agents capable of autonomous planning, tool use, and complex task execution. Financial analysis requires these agents to integrate cross-document evidence and perform multistep numerical reasoning, but expert task authoring is costly, while direct LLM synthesis struggles to produce challenging tasks with reliable answers. We introduce Navalia, a framework for
items.summary_zh: Navalia 通过可验证任务合成与长程后训练，提升 Cowork Agent 在金融分析中跨文档证据整合与多步数值推理能力。
items.why_zh: 演示如何用合成数据与长程 RL 强化 Agent 复杂推理，属 Agent 训练数据构建与评估技能点。

items.title: pinganbbOvO/ai-companion-kit
items.summary: 给你的 AI 一副身体，和一点人味 —— 会记事、会看场合的 QQ 陪聊 + 能控制安卓手机的 MCP
items.summary_zh: ai-companion-kit 实现具备记忆、场景感知的 QQ 陪聊机器人，并通过 MCP 控制安卓手机，赋予 AI “身体”。
items.why_zh: 展示 MCP 协议在移动端控制与长期记忆人格化 Agent 的工程集成，属多模态交互与工具链落地技能点。

items.title: zhu1090093659/dsh-web
items.summary: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web 插件聚合生态 · 万物皆插件，通过创意工坊分发｜｜DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web Plugin Aggregation Ecosystem · Everything is a plugin, distributed via the Creative Workshop
items.summary_zh: dsh-web 构建 DeepSeek Harness 插件聚合生态，采用“万物皆插件”架构并通过创意工坊分发，支持 Web 侧功能扩展。
items.why_zh: 提供插件化架构设计与生态分发的完整案例，属 LLM 应用工程化与插件系统设计技能点。

items.title: wh000wh000/awesome-jev-live
items.summary: Awesome Jev — evidence-graded index of TypeSafe System One: SDKs, MCP tools, agents, apps and open models. 20 languages, rebuilt every 2 hours.
items.summary_zh: awesome-jev-live 持续维护 20 语言的 TypeSafe System One 生态索引，按证据分级收录 SDK、MCP 工具、Agent 与开放模型，每 2 小时重建。
items.why_zh: 展示大规模多语言工具链自动化采集、评分与持续集成流程，属开发者工具链工程化与数据治理技能点。

items.title: respanai/respan-gateway
items.summary: One endpoint for every LLM vendor. Any SDK, any model, any tool. One Rust binary.
items.summary_zh: respan-gateway 是 Rust 编写的单二进制文件，提供统一端点以兼容任意 LLM 供应商、SDK 及工具链。
items.why_zh: 涉及 LLM 基础设施开发，可学习用 Rust 构建高性能 API 网关以统一多厂商接口，降低集成复杂度。

items.title: Publish fake stats, get cited in LLMs
items.summary_zh: 分析伪造统计数据被 LLM 引用的现象，揭示模型在训练数据中吸收虚假信息并生成错误引用的机制。
items.why_zh: 幻觉检测与数据溯源。掌握 RAG 系统中引用验证逻辑，防止模型基于噪声数据输出错误事实。

items.title: NVIDIA Kumo Forecast Combines Pretrained Time-Series Representations with Historical Pattern Retrieval and Interpretability
items.summary_zh: NVIDIA 发布 Kumo Forecast，结合预训练时序表征、历史模式检索及可解释性，提升时间序列预测能力。
items.why_zh: 涉及时序基础模型架构，学习如何将历史检索（Retrieval）引入预测模型以提高可解释性与准确性。

items.title: Claude Mods: Flipping the Harness Inside Out
items.summary: Claude Mods is an early form of the Attention Interface. It flips the agent harness paradigm from the harness facing the machine, to the harness facing the human.
items.summary_zh: Claude Mods 被视为 Attention Interface 早期形式，将 Agent Harness 范式从面向机器反转为面向人类。
items.why_zh: 深入 Agent 交互设计，理解人机协作界面（HMI）在智能体系统中的角色，优化 Agent 的可控性与透明度。

items.title: Prompt Injection Is Just the Start of AI Agent Security (Here's What You Need)
items.summary: Learn more about agent security here: https://fandf.co/4i1Qs4u My second brain helps me run my entire business, and that means giving it access to a lot of my systems and data, so I check everything it pulls in and keep its access limited. That works for one agent. A company has agents running across cloud platforms and employee devices, and IT has to know which ones exist, who owns them, and what they can reach. Microsoft is expanding Project Perception, building on Agent 365, to secure AI agen…
items.summary_zh: Cole Medin 阐述 Agent 安全超越 Prompt Injection 的需求，强调企业级多 Agent 系统的权限控制与监控。
items.why_zh: 聚焦 Agent 运维与安全（DevSecOps），学习在分布式环境中管理 Agent 身份、权限边界及审计日志的最佳实践。

items.title: [AINews] DeepSeek DeepInfer: Open Source SOTA Inference running 155T toks/day/cluster making $22m/day at ~80% margin for a 81 day payback
items.summary: An open source “bomb” drops from China
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 开源 DeepInfer 推理引擎，宣称集群日处理 155T token，日收益 2200 万美元，成本回收仅 81 天。
items.why_zh: 涉及 LLM 推理优化与 MLOps 经济模型，分析高吞吐量推理架构及其对降低 AI 服务边际成本的商业影响。

items.title: Build a Better Shopping Experience with OpenAI | Shopping Agent Demo
items.summary: See how an AI shopping agent can turn a room photo into a personalized shopping experience—from finding the right products to updating an order. In this demo for fictional home goods retailer Vesper & Alder, a shopper uses voice and images to create a cozy reading nook. The agent recommends products, generates a preview of the room, adjusts selections to fit a $250 budget, and suggests a complementary throw blanket. After checkout, it helps switch the order from store pickup to home delivery—all…
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 演示 AI 购物代理：用语音和房间照片生成个性化推荐、房间预览并按 250 美元预算调整选品。
items.why_zh: 展示多模态 Agent 编排、工具调用与预算约束下的决策链，适合学习 Agent 规划与多模态交互设计。

items.title: You need a better headshot.
items.summary: THIS JUST IN: You need a better headshot. Create yours now on ChatGPT Images.
items.summary_zh: ChatGPT Images 推出一键生成专业头像功能，用户可直接在聊天界面制作高质量证件照。
